text_sections.label: Effect
text_sections.text: [Security] At the end of the battle, play this card without paying the cost. [On Play] [When Digivolving] You may return 1 Digimon card with the [Appmon] trait from your trash to the hand.

text_sections.label: Inherited Effect
text_sections.text: ＜Link＞ [Appmon] trait: Cost 2 (Plug this card from the hand or battle area sideways into the specified Digimon in the battle area.) [When Linking] You may return 1 Digimon card with the [Appmon] trait from your trash to the hand.
